name: Jims Close Positions
summary: This EA is a utility tool designed to close all open positions or pending orders on the current account. It provides a quick one-click or automated mechanism to liquidate all exposure, commonly used as an emergency exit or end-of-day cleanup tool.
summary_zh: 这个EA是一个工具类程序，用于一键平仓当前账户上所有持仓或挂单。它提供快速清算所有敞口的机制，通常用作紧急退出或每日收盘清理工具。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略程序，而是一个仓位管理工具。它的核心功能是遍历账户上所有未平仓头寸并执行平仓操作，不涉及任何入场信号或技术指标分析。出场条件即用户触发平仓操作，程序会逐个关闭所有持仓。仓位管理方面，该工具不涉及建仓逻辑，仅处理平仓。资金管理方面，它不具备资金管理功能，仅作为风险控制的辅助工具使用。常见应用场景包括紧急止损清算、每日收盘前批量平仓、以及配合其他EA进行联合风险管理。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy program but a position management utility. Its core function is to iterate through all open positions on the account and execute close operations, without involving any entry signals or technical indicator analysis. The exit condition is simply the user triggering the close operation, and the program closes all positions one by one. In terms of position sizing, this tool does not involve any order opening logic and only handles closing. For money management, it has no money management functionality and serves only as an auxiliary risk control tool. Common use cases include emergency stop-loss liquidation, batch closing before daily settlement, and coordinated risk management with other EAs.

parameters.name: ClosePending
parameters.description_en: Whether to also delete pending orders

parameters.name: CloseBySymbol
parameters.description: 是否仅关闭指定品种的持仓
parameters.description_en: Close positions only for specified symbol

parameters.name: SymbolFilter
parameters.description: 指定需要平仓的交易品种
parameters.description_en: Trading symbol to close positions for

parameters.name: CloseByType
parameters.description: 按方向过滤平仓：0=全部，1=仅多单，2=仅空单

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定EA魔法号过滤，-1表示全部

pros: 一键快速平仓所有持仓，操作简便高效
支持按品种、方向、魔法号等多维度过滤平仓，灵活性强
可作为紧急风险控制工具，在市场剧烈波动时快速止损退出
pros_en: One-click fast closing of all positions, simple and efficient operation
Supports multi-dimensional filtering by symbol, direction, magic number for flexible closing
Can serve as an emergency risk control tool for quick stop-loss exit during extreme market volatility
cons: 不具备交易信号生成能力，仅能被动平仓无法主动建仓
批量平仓时可能因市场流动性不足导致滑点较大
缺乏平仓确认和部分平仓功能，操作不可逆且无法精细控制
cons_en: No trading signal generation capability, can only passively close positions without active order opening
Batch closing may result in significant slippage due to insufficient market liquidity
Lacks close confirmation and partial close functionality, operations are irreversible without fine-grained control
improvements: 增加部分平仓功能，允许用户指定平仓比例而非全部平仓
添加平仓前确认对话框和滑点预警机制，防止误操作
improvements_en: Add partial close functionality allowing users to specify close percentage rather than all-or-nothing
Add pre-close confirmation dialog and slippage warning mechanism to prevent accidental operations

risk_points: 批量平仓在高波动时可能遭遇较大滑点
一键平仓无二次确认可能导致误操作
risk_points_en: Batch closing may encounter significant slippage during high volatility
One-click close without secondary confirmation may lead to accidental operations

summary_en: This EA is a utility tool designed to close all open positions or pending orders on the current account. It provides a quick one-click or automated mechanism to liquidate all exposure, commonly used as an emergency exit or end-of-day cleanup tool.
